Definition: Reserved system field that links the row to its underlying bibliographic record and enables source-level inspection and export.
Categories Or Format: One linked study record per row
Notes: System linkage; not an analytical variable.

Definition: Level at which eligibility was checked for inclusion in the catalog.
Categories Or Format: Full-text confirmed; Title/abstract screened — full text unretrieved
Notes: Use this field to separate the confirmed evidence set from provisional candidates.

Definition: Publication or posting year available in the bibliographic record.
Notes: Preprint year and journal-publication year can differ.

Definition: Publication venue, preprint server, or other hosting venue listed in bibliographic metadata.
Notes: Not a normalized journal-title authority field.

Definition: Journal quality quartile provided in bibliographic metadata for the publication venue.
Categories Or Format: Q1; Q2; Q3; Q4; Not reported (preprint, conference record, or unavailable)
Notes: Not applicable or unavailable for many preprints and non-journal records.

Definition: A persistent study identifier when verified, otherwise a verification status.
Categories Or Format: DOI; PMID; trial identifier; canonical title; Not independently verified
Notes: Most confirmed records use a DOI.

Definition: Whether the study explicitly reports public deposition of its own generated data, with repository and accession or link when stated.
Categories Or Format: Yes — [repository]: [accession/link or dataset name]; No public repository stated; Not established in title/abstract
Notes: Public reference datasets reused by a study do not count as a deposit of that study’s own data; availability on request does not count as public-repository availability.

Definition: Qualifying transcriptomic assay or assay combination used to study human liver material.
Categories Or Format: scRNA-seq; snRNA-seq; spatial Omics; scRNA-seq + snRNA-seq; scRNA-seq + spatial Omics; snRNA-seq + spatial Omics; scRNA-seq + snRNA-seq + spatial Omics; Not established in available text
Notes: Does not count bulk RNA-seq, scATAC-seq, or validation-only FISH/IHC as a qualifying modality.

Definition: Requested disease or tissue-context categories explicitly stated for directly profiled human liver material.
Categories Or Format: healthy; tumor; cirrhosis; MASLD; transplant; combinations joined by +; None of requested categories stated
Notes: MASLD includes NAFLD, fatty liver, MASH, NASH, and steatosis. Tumor includes primary liver tumors and liver metastases.

Definition: Number and type of unique human donors, patients, or individuals whose liver material was profiled by the qualifying assay.
Categories Or Format: Free-text count with cohort descriptors; Not reported in available text; Ambiguous
Notes: Cell and nuclei counts are not substituted for individual counts unless the individual count is unavailable.

Definition: Named platform used for a qualifying spatial transcriptomic or spatial gene-expression assay.
Categories Or Format: Examples: 10x Visium; MERFISH; NanoString GeoMx DSP; Molecular Cartography; multiple platforms separated by semicolons; Not applicable—no spatial omics in qualifying assay; Not reported in available text
Notes: Platform is not inferred from non-spatial validation methods.

Definition: Textual evidence available for the cohort-size and spatial-platform fields.
Notes: This is a field-level evidence qualifier, distinct from overall Evidence Status.

Definition: Concise statement of the study’s primary objective.
Notes: Derived from the stated study aim; it is not a result summary.

Definition: Up to four concise, study-level findings.
Categories Or Format: Bulleted free text; fewer than four bullets when available text is limited
Notes: Full-text-confirmed rows use retrievable manuscripts; provisional rows are limited to title/abstract-supported findings.
